thread: oliver (PM): Quick sync on the compliance panel microcopy & badges. Running into a few debates: retention wording, how we label region, and the encryption badge name. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/compliance-panel-v2 (frame: 'Org > Compliance - compact'). jin (Designer): dropped a compact layout with three-row cards. Two copy options for retention: 'Retention period' vs 'Store until removed'. Which reads better in the compact UI? Also experimenting with 'Residency' vs 'Region' as the dropdown label. design-bot: jin updated 'Org > Compliance - compact' 4dd 1772034260 tara (Security): Some security notes: - Don't expose raw vendor acronyms as main labels. Replace 'KMS' with 'Customer key' + short parenthetical 'BYOK'. - Show a discrete compatibility hint when a customer uploads/links a key (e.g., small line: 'Key may be region-restricted'). - For encryption status, recommend two short badges: 'Redwood encryption' and 'Customer key (BYOK)'. mike (Eng): technical constraints: - 'Store until removed' will map to a boolean 'manual_delete=true' server-side. Fine, just flag infra. - Residency label change is purely client-side mapping. Backend keeps 'region' codes. - For key checks we can run a background validation call and expose results in the card; fallback to 'Unknown compatibility' until validated. samir (Accessibility): Quick a11y pass: - Retention control needs a clear label + helper text linked via aria-describedby. - For the badges: ensure text contrast >= 4.5:1 and provide `role=\"status\"` announcements when the badge changes. - Dropdown focus: visible focus ring (2px) and an aria-live polite update when the region changes: "Data residency set to EU-West (Ireland)". ana (Legal): prefer 'Data residency' in tooltip/help text for legal compliance docs, but 'Region' is fine as the primary compact label so it doesn't wrap. Can we do 'Region' with help text 'Data residency'? jin (Designer): proposal to keep compact label 'Region' and surface 'Data residency' in the help tooltip. Retention: use 'Retention period' with options '30 days', '90 days', 'Keep until removed'. Tooltip: 'Keep until removed: retained until an admin deletes it.' tara (Security): one more micro-copy tweak: for BYOK tooltip use 'Customer key (BYOK) - you manage the encryption key via your cloud KMS. Some keys are tied to a physical region.' Add a link to docs. mike (Eng): small snippet for aria-describedby pattern for the region help icon: ``` Data residency: physical location(s) where we store your data. ``` We can reuse this across settings pages. samir (Accessibility): also ensure the help button is keyboard focusable and the tooltip content gets focus when opened. If retention switches to 'Keep until removed', use `aria-live=\"polite\"` to announce: "Retention set to Keep until removed. Data will not be auto-deleted." ana (Legal): for the audit control language, legal prefers 'audit report' if the download includes summaries. If it's raw events, 'audit log' or 'audit events' is better. What are we returning? mike (Eng): backend returns raw events CSV/json. So technically 'Download audit log' or 'Download audit events' is accurate. 'Audit report' would be misleading. jin (Designer): new copy set I'm pushing: - Retention label: 'Retention period' - Options: '30 days', '90 days', 'Keep until removed' - Region label: 'Region' (help: 'Data residency: where your data is stored') - Encryption badge: 'Redwood encryption' / 'Customer key (BYOK)' - BYOK tooltip: 'Bring your own key; you control the key in your cloud KMS. Some keys are regional. See docs.' - Audit CTA: 'Download audit log' (button) oliver (PM): sounds good. Action items: - Jin: finalize Figma with the help aria pattern and add the 'status' announcement behavior to the badge states. - Mike: add the manual_delete flag and the key compatibility validation endpoint integration. - Tara: write the BYOK tooltip and a 2-line checklist for customers about region/rotation. - Samir: produce a 4-point a11y checklist for this panel (labels, live announcements, focus states, contrast). jin (Designer): will update and ping for quick sign-off. Quick poll: 'Keep until removed' vs 'Until deleted' for the shortest text? Thoughts? samir (Accessibility): 'Until deleted' is shorter but ambiguous. 'Keep until removed' reads clearer for screen readers. I'd vote for 'Keep until removed'. tara (Security): +1 for 'Keep until removed'. Also add a small inline confirmation modal when choosing that option so admins acknowledge retention behaviour. oliver (PM): agree. Let's lock those strings and ship the PR for copy changes. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
